title: Handle an absent value
summary: F#: Handle an absent value. Use Some 8. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: An option is Some(value) or None. Pattern matching handles both.
learningObjectives: Handle an absent value with F#

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Handle an absent value
blocks.code:
let score: int option = None
let value = match score with | Some n -> n | None -> 0
printfn "%d" value

blocks.text: None selects the fallback branch and returns 0.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Handle None instead of assuming a value exists.
